summary: scripts/check-main-ci and scripts/ci-queue-watch count fractal-web among main's required checks, as the live ruleset does: a red fractal-web on a merge-group SHA now fails the main check, and a queue run is finished only when fractal-web has completed too.

replay.detail: CI scripts and their test only; no claims or projections change.

compatibility.detail: No API, CLI or wire change. The fractal-web job always runs in merge groups (it passes when no web path changed), so the required set is always present.
